` [Highlight start] It is best to avoid mixing melatonin and alcohol [Highlight end] ` . Combining them increases drowsiness and can worsen sleep quality rather than improve it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXBgH92QzPrYilsFljUJ_j6G2J2LzT-CKcLF2h0UDhSZ0d_N2dBNG-4IdIymgCdx1iYxCE9fp71c3IzysAKBv6kndpJSi018HzUiOJ6h1uKIZoAznbsjZbq8MQC-NCcsm0s3RfgXWkG1QWNGZ6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1sscGZHvES5sdSMWPlxeDXC_qSzjS5joKTqvYrsFxU1_c97_HybGT381Wjj-IRhBhFDfSGZQogHBO_R7fR4wJw3S1a8C2yozGDCrnlnKyTn_nmpIe_6xX-3EtXfa8cvRjKYtSBhlmix_EX6SCA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXDla7BHSsYdedLEyfi2KuUobH1twlG5DkwSLjeIg2eDHQTTeM4-zt0JSY_-4UnMj3x5iPjw4hEX0yEeXwLvNiZh60XTD3pSU3hoJ_lKYCi98NeLUVLvsFusVUa2BpAbUXe8Qjh_kJrKbF21WvFAz7jNtAeyvP)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXWkyZAfXKJ8D7Ltq_3fEPy1BbRFY97UhTEf93bFdy2bA3Dmo7PqLUDYebvfp8A98Gd0pB2dWbdoBkNLXCBBVzaSNDJ_6uQpM2a22XKX-PfhN-73C-Wi2A0fIaGExSVFk2)

### Key Risks and Effects

- **Heightened sedation:** Both substances slow central nervous system activity, which can cause excessive drowsiness, dizziness, grogginess, impaired thinking, or trouble waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1sscGZHvES5sdSMWPlxeDXC_qSzjS5joKTqvYrsFxU1_c97_HybGT381Wjj-IRhBhFDfSGZQogHBO_R7fR4wJw3S1a8C2yozGDCrnlnKyTn_nmpIe_6xX-3EtXfa8cvRjKYtSBhlmix_EX6SCA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXDla7BHSsYdedLEyfi2KuUobH1twlG5DkwSLjeIg2eDHQTTeM4-zt0JSY_-4UnMj3x5iPjw4hEX0yEeXwLvNiZh60XTD3pSU3hoJ_lKYCi98NeLUVLvsFusVUa2BpAbUXe8Qjh_kJrKbF21WvFAz7jNtAeyvP)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXBgH92QzPrYilsFljUJ_j6G2J2LzT-CKcLF2h0UDhSZ0d_N2dBNG-4IdIymgCdx1iYxCE9fp71c3IzysAKBv6kndpJSi018HzUiOJ6h1uKIZoAznbsjZbq8MQC-NCcsm0s3RfgXWkG1QWNGZ6)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF13nz0fwDDeQw776BYay3eAfPJ_V3Qafb9Af6I--CilyrQVgAQoTl28kS28ujnc1Jlm4WksCL97Jug1ZrGmCLOcVR0Ld2RimVBrojGOOmoeM1VaW6mJWtXxBMFQLa3Ey5X5t8pRqrOx2XHDCXwfnahR1NaKjKCb4nzpDOkqq3)
- **Worse sleep architecture:** Alcohol suppresses REM sleep and causes nighttime awakenings, and melatonin does not reliably fix alcohol-disrupted sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXBgH92QzPrYilsFljUJ_j6G2J2LzT-CKcLF2h0UDhSZ0d_N2dBNG-4IdIymgCdx1iYxCE9fp71c3IzysAKBv6kndpJSi018HzUiOJ6h1uKIZoAznbsjZbq8MQC-NCcsm0s3RfgXWkG1QWNGZ6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXYiTSgoONyQt2sAVl_Tq4dbKYYo78MetbUxWdACKws5VG-mGRZuyw5v_trBoZCrmJ0RMej94PoO_UbnfdL2CTmwLEtUckZ83nKy2-ST7iWt9AanKgLI9S2JsLg7Vs_-ZUm2_zGxqh)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXWkyZAfXKJ8D7Ltq_3fEPy1BbRFY97UhTEf93bFdy2bA3Dmo7PqLUDYebvfp8A98Gd0pB2dWbdoBkNLXCBBVzaSNDJ_6uQpM2a22XKX-PfhN-73C-Wi2A0fIaGExSVFk2)
- **Breathing and fall risks:** Relaxed airway muscles can worsen snoring or sleep apnea, and extra sedation raises fall risks—especially for older adults.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF13nz0fwDDeQw776BYay3eAfPJ_V3Qafb9Af6I--CilyrQVgAQoTl28kS28ujnc1Jlm4WksCL97Jug1ZrGmCLOcVR0Ld2RimVBrojGOOmoeM1VaW6mJWtXxBMFQLa3Ey5X5t8pRqrOx2XHDCXwfnahR1NaKjKCb4nzpDOkqq3)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXDla7BHSsYdedLEyfi2KuUobH1twlG5DkwSLjeIg2eDHQTTeM4-zt0JSY_-4UnMj3x5iPjw4hEX0yEeXwLvNiZh60XTD3pSU3hoJ_lKYCi98NeLUVLvsFusVUa2BpAbUXe8Qjh_kJrKbF21WvFAz7jNtAeyvP)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXYiTSgoONyQt2sAVl_Tq4dbKYYo78MetbUxWdACKws5VG-mGRZuyw5v_trBoZCrmJ0RMej94PoO_UbnfdL2CTmwLEtUckZ83nKy2-ST7iWt9AanKgLI9S2JsLg7Vs_-ZUm2_zGxqh)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7pajsbvzihVdItIpQYyJoXjY_2LgOgbVcFsx9hBkd5hy7KA9V7_NH_Arr6KWhcKJS7E7uxuD1cvRdXhfMW_0_YcK-18Xvi_ogAVqEWztBU_FC9d0Mwz_Vdvxu7Uvq62IOD7xH_Xv)
- **Other possible side effects:** People occasionally report headaches, anxiety, vivid dreams, or stomach upset.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7pajsbvzihVdItIpQYyJoXjY_2LgOgbVcFsx9hBkd5hy7KA9V7_NH_Arr6KWhcKJS7E7uxuD1cvRdXhfMW_0_YcK-18Xvi_ogAVqEWztBU_FC9d0Mwz_Vdvxu7Uvq62IOD7xH_Xv)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1sscGZHvES5sdSMWPlxeDXC_qSzjS5joKTqvYrsFxU1_c97_HybGT381Wjj-IRhBhFDfSGZQogHBO_R7fR4wJw3S1a8C2yozGDCrnlnKyTn_nmpIe_6xX-3EtXfa8cvRjKYtSBhlmix_EX6SCA)

For more details on potential side effects and label guidance, see the [Sleep Foundation](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXDla7BHSsYdedLEyfi2KuUobH1twlG5DkwSLjeIg2eDHQTTeM4-zt0JSY_-4UnMj3x5iPjw4hEX0yEeXwLvNiZh60XTD3pSU3hoJ_lKYCi98NeLUVLvsFusVUa2BpAbUXe8Qjh_kJrKbF21WvFAz7jNtAeyvP) and [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1sscGZHvES5sdSMWPlxeDXC_qSzjS5joKTqvYrsFxU1_c97_HybGT381Wjj-IRhBhFDfSGZQogHBO_R7fR4wJw3S1a8C2yozGDCrnlnKyTn_nmpIe_6xX-3EtXfa8cvRjKYtSBhlmix_EX6SCA) . On [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF1x6_MItQKmpIsMZJskd5eCfQ-UJ3cJBdYLFBg4sCyI62G8nnW3PFdUv6JQg54YxhLwy538g61YrIAvCY2nqPl8gB8ZYcFv5h1_W8rfO47CVAqg31LVz6UlRMdLQjRB7gXbWXy3GdxW2yCXSW4W1sKAIgZHU-zxZt5-VXv3iYyU7zPqzJAPcDDtXbQZfmlGDZS0PjhZij) , opinions are mixed: many users warn against combining them due to next-day grogginess or disrupted sleep, while a few suggest a low dose with a couple of drinks feels mild since melatonin is naturally produced in the body.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXDla7BHSsYdedLEyfi2KuUobH1twlG5DkwSLjeIg2eDHQTTeM4-zt0JSY_-4UnMj3x5iPjw4hEX0yEeXwLvNiZh60XTD3pSU3hoJ_lKYCi98NeLUVLvsFusVUa2BpAbUXe8Qjh_kJrKbF21WvFAz7jNtAeyvP)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1sscGZHvES5sdSMWPlxeDXC_qSzjS5joKTqvYrsFxU1_c97_HybGT381Wjj-IRhBhFDfSGZQogHBO_R7fR4wJw3S1a8C2yozGDCrnlnKyTn_nmpIe_6xX-3EtXfa8cvRjKYtSBhlmix_EX6SCA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF1x6_MItQKmpIsMZJskd5eCfQ-UJ3cJBdYLFBg4sCyI62G8nnW3PFdUv6JQg54YxhLwy538g61YrIAvCY2nqPl8gB8ZYcFv5h1_W8rfO47CVAqg31LVz6UlRMdLQjRB7gXbWXy3GdxW2yCXSW4W1sKAIgZHU-zxZt5-VXv3iYyU7zPqzJAPcDDtXbQZfmlGDZS0PjhZij)

### Practical Guidance

- **If you drink:** Skip your melatonin dose that night and wait until you have been alcohol-free for about 24 hours before taking it again.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXBgH92QzPrYilsFljUJ_j6G2J2LzT-CKcLF2h0UDhSZ0d_N2dBNG-4IdIymgCdx1iYxCE9fp71c3IzysAKBv6kndpJSi018HzUiOJ6h1uKIZoAznbsjZbq8MQC-NCcsm0s3RfgXWkG1QWNGZ6)
- **If you take melatonin:** Because melatonin typically clears the body in roughly 5 to 10 hours, some guidance suggests waiting at least a few hours after a nighttime dose before having a drink the next day—though avoiding alcohol when managing sleep is generally more effective.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXBgH92QzPrYilsFljUJ_j6G2J2LzT-CKcLF2h0UDhSZ0d_N2dBNG-4IdIymgCdx1iYxCE9fp71c3IzysAKBv6kndpJSi018HzUiOJ6h1uKIZoAznbsjZbq8MQC-NCcsm0s3RfgXWkG1QWNGZ6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1sscGZHvES5sdSMWPlxeDXC_qSzjS5joKTqvYrsFxU1_c97_HybGT381Wjj-IRhBhFDfSGZQogHBO_R7fR4wJw3S1a8C2yozGDCrnlnKyTn_nmpIe_6xX-3EtXfa8cvRjKYtSBhlmix_EX6SCA)
- **Check medications:** Melatonin can interact with certain drugs (such as blood thinners, immunosuppressants, diabetes medications, or birth control), so check with a pharmacist or doctor if you take regular medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1sscGZHvES5sdSMWPlxeDXC_qSzjS5joKTqvYrsFxU1_c97_HybGT381Wjj-IRhBhFDfSGZQogHBO_R7fR4wJw3S1a8C2yozGDCrnlnKyTn_nmpIe_6xX-3EtXfa8cvRjKYtSBhlmix_EX6SCA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF13nz0fwDDeQw776BYay3eAfPJ_V3Qafb9Af6I--CilyrQVgAQoTl28kS28ujnc1Jlm4WksCL97Jug1ZrGmCLOcVR0Ld2RimVBrojGOOmoeM1VaW6mJWtXxBMFQLa3Ey5X5t8pRqrOx2XHDCXwfnahR1NaKjKCb4nzpDOkqq3)

items.title: Practical Guidance
items.text: If you drink: Skip your melatonin dose that night and wait until you have been alcohol-free for about 24 hours before taking it again. If you take melatonin: Because melatonin typically clears the body in roughly 5 to 10 hours, some guidance suggests waiting at least a few hours after a nighttime dose before having a drink the next day—though avoiding alcohol when managing sleep is generally more effective. Check medications: Melatonin can interact with certain drugs (such as blood thinners, immunosuppressants, diabetes medications, or birth control), so check with a pharmacist or doctor if you take regular medications.
